name: Living In Sin
overview: Scripture clearly condemns living in sin, emphasizing that continuing in sin to exploit grace is unacceptable (Romans 6:1). The carnal mind, being hostile to God, cannot submit to His law (Romans 8:7), and the works of the flesh—including adultery and fornication—are evident and contrary to a Spirit-led life (Galatians 5:16, 19). Believers are called to seek heavenly things in Christ and avoid willful sin after receiving the truth, as there is no further sacrifice for deliberate transgression (Colossians 3:1; Hebrews 10:26).
